prompts.enrichment: Generate a rich 150-200 word English description for the airport {{name}} ({{iata}}/{{icao}}) located in {{city}}, {{country}}. Include: 1) Brief history/origin, 2) Notable features or terminal info, 3) Common traveler tips (transit, food, transport links). Style: informative, factual, traveler-friendly. Output ONLY the description text, no headers or markdown.
